quotes.text: The D207127 reviewer questioned apparent recursive sorting and display churn. The landed view setter reads sortColumn and sortDirection from xulStore, calls view.sortBy before super.view, then updates the header. Sorting before attachment avoids showing unsorted rows and redrawing them immediately. Current code preserves that order; its header update now uses aria-sort based on the view’s accepted values.
